summary: Implementation plan for the Sub-Tile Micro-Composer (2x2 8px quadrants & 4x4 4px micro-blocks baked to an offscreen atlas cache), Multi-Pass 2.5D Post-Processing & Visual Effect Layers (dynamic lighting/bloom, blade trails, projectile glow, automatic sprite outlines, water reflections, biome weather, and desync shader pass), and Authoring Guide updates.
